tools.name: search_nc_wedding_directory
tools.description: Search nearly 4,000 North Carolina wedding venues and vendors by category, city, or free text. Returns canonical listing URLs and structured planning details.

tools.name: get_nc_wedding_vendor
tools.description: Get structured details for one venue or vendor using the category and slug returned by search_nc_wedding_directory.

tools.name: estimate_nc_venue_cost
tools.description: Estimate site fee, food and beverage, and total venue cost by NC region, guest count, day, and season.

tools.name: build_nc_wedding_budget
tools.description: Allocate a total wedding budget across eight categories using NC market-informed weights.

tools.name: lookup_nc_marriage_license
tools.description: Find a highlighted NC Register of Deeds office and statewide marriage-license rules by county, city, or region.

tools.name: request_vendor_contact
tools.description: Record high-intent contact interest, then receive the listing's public email and a prepared wedding inquiry. NC Wedding Guide does not forward or deliver the message yet; the returned email or mailto URL must be used to contact the business.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_nc_wedding_directory, request_vendor_contact · Private data: request_vendor_contact · Public sink: request_vendor_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_nc_wedding_directory, request_vendor_contact · Private data: request_vendor_contact · Public sink: request_vendor_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
